Sample.evidence_source: [page/6/Text/6] Results of this study provide preliminary support for the efficacy of our combined CBT family education intervention. When compared to children in the control condition, children in the intervention group were more likely to show reductions in depressive symptoms, negative cognitions, and internalizing coping (depressive and anxious responses to stress).
